verification_notes: This dataset covers public and private universities from current nationwide university listings cross-checked with the UGC university directory.
Where only a city/locality was available in the source, university_address and campus address use that locality rather than an invented street address.
Newly approved, renamed, suspended, or not-yet-operational universities can cause totals to differ between UGC registration and operating-university lists.

sources.name: Bangladesh National Portal public university list citing UGC Bangladesh
UGC Bangladesh private university directory mirror
